title: Gold-blind repeated-position retrieval screen on LongMemEval-S

definitions.retrieval unit: One supplied LongMemEval haystack session identified by its supplied session identifier and containing its ordered role/content messages.
definitions.repeated adjacent-position association: An unordered token-pair edge supported by adjacent messages in at least two distinct supplied sessions; it is association evidence, never causal evidence.
definitions.gold-blind treatment projection: A recursively reconstructed object containing only question_id, question, and first-occurrence sessions with session_id plus ordered role/content messages; it excludes answer, answer-session identifiers, question type, has_answer, dates, and inferred labels.
definitions.content retrieval: BM25 ranking over the exact same normalized session corpus without any association edge.
definitions.public Agent experiment: A future separately preregistered evaluation on a revision-pinned public model; this retrieval-only run is not that experiment.

question: Under the same raw session corpus and returned-session count, does repeated adjacent-position association improve held-out answer-session retrieval over content BM25, recurrence without position, and shuffled-position controls without unacceptable knowledge-update errors or index cost?

primary.statement: Repeated adjacent-position evaluation NDCG@10 exceeds content BM25 by at least 0.02 absolute and its paired bootstrap lower 95 percent bound is greater than zero.
Repeated adjacent-position evaluation NDCG@10 separately exceeds recurrence without position and shuffled position by at least 0.02 absolute with each paired lower bound greater than zero.

guardrails.statement: Repeated adjacent-position top-one error on knowledge-update questions is no more than 0.02 absolute worse than content BM25.

Repeated adjacent-position p95 per-question canonical-edge-bytes divided by normalized-raw-session-bytes is at most 2. Build and query milliseconds are descriptive environment observations rather than a scientific decision gate.

Treatment projection, indexing, graph construction, and ranking never receive answer, answer-session identifiers, question type, has_answer, dates, inferred gold, or record-role labels. Only the separate development selector and analyzer join persisted rankings to distinct gold session identifiers.

decision.currentProductState: The latest private-Aether task-state result rejected association raw, checkpoints, and their composition. Raw association remains only a retrieval hypothesis because its prior packets were built from known record roles. Automatic recall is unimplemented and rejected by configuration.
changesIfSupported: Retain repeated adjacent-position raw retrieval only as a factor in a separately preregistered public revision-pinned Agent experiment.
Keep retrieval explicit, source-cited, bounded, independently deletable, and disabled by default.
Do not carry the rejected checkpoint or checkpoint-plus-raw representations into that experiment.
changesIfRejected: Do not implement a repeated-position association index in Dolly Memory.
Retain content retrieval while any different retrieval hypothesis requires a new preregistration.
Do not rescue a valid rejection with prior synthetic or private-Aether results.
prohibitedClaims: This retrieval-only run cannot establish language-model, Agent, Memory product, or automatic-resume efficacy.
Repeated proximity is not position semantics or causal inference.
A supported retrieval result cannot enable automatic injection, tool execution, task resumption, or a Module launch.
No result may remove, weaken, or bypass the public Module startup refusal.

baselines.description: BM25 ranks the exact first-occurrence normalized session corpus without an association graph.

frozenParameters.emptyDocumentRule: document length zero; if corpus average length is zero every BM25 score is zero

treatments.description: BM25 is augmented by token-pair recurrence across any two distinct messages in a session with position ignored.
BM25 is augmented only by token-pair recurrence from supplied adjacent messages in at least two sessions.
Messages are deterministically shuffled inside each session before applying the identical adjacent-position edge rule.

frozenParameters.shuffleSeed: first four SHA-256 bytes interpreted unsigned big-endian over UTF-8 question_id, NUL, session_id, NUL, position-shuffle

generatorOrDataset.contentDefinition: The local MIT-licensed LongMemEval-S file contains exactly 500 questions. Answer may be text or number. The adapter validates source alignment, first-occurrence session identity, duplicate equality, and gold membership, then recursively constructs the closed gold-blind projection; no original row or message object enters treatment code.

training.name: training-unused
caseFactors: No training rows or fitted model exist; these two identifiers are reserved and unused.

development.name: development
caseFactors: Exactly 147 questions: knowledge-update 23, multi-session 39, single-session-assistant 16, single-session-preference 9, single-session-user 21, temporal-reasoning 39.

The treatment writes 588 condition rows and 1911 weight-specific ranking vectors; a separate gold-aware selector chooses one association weight per treatment by unrounded macro NDCG@10 and breaks exact ties toward the smaller weight.

evaluation.name: evaluation
caseFactors: Exactly 353 questions: knowledge-update 55, multi-session 94, single-session-assistant 40, single-session-preference 21, single-session-user 49, temporal-reasoning 94.
Exactly 1412 condition rows and 1412 ranking vectors at persisted selected weights, with metrics at cutoffs one, five, and ten.

data.splitIsolation: Question type is read only by the split driver. The adapter persists membership, recursively reconstructs first-occurrence session objects containing only session_id and role/content messages, and passes no source row or source message object to treatment. The treatment writes rankings before the separate selector receives gold. Evaluation cannot change any rule.

randomness.generator: xorshift32 with JavaScript 32-bit bitwise transitions x^=x<<13, x^=x>>>17, x^=x<<5; shuffle and bootstrap map unsigned output with floor(output*bound/4294967296)
randomness.streamSeparation: Position shuffle seeds are the first four big-endian digest bytes independently derived per question and session. One unstratified bootstrap index matrix from seed 1296387376 is reused for all three paired contrasts and consumes no shuffle state.
randomness.executionOrder: Question rows use UTF-16 code-unit ascending question_id and conditions use content, recurrence-no-position, repeated-adjacent-position, then shuffled-position. Rankings use the frozen score and identifier tie break.

primary.name: ndcg-at-10
primary.aggregation: Binary relevance over distinct gold and returned session identifiers; macro mean by condition and exact paired condition differences with one shared 10000-resample unstratified nearest-rank percentile bootstrap.
primary.population: Every held-out evaluation question with at least one supplied answer-session identifier.

secondary.name: answer-session-recall
secondary.aggregation: Macro mean reported separately at cutoffs one, five, and ten by split and condition.
secondary.population: All development and evaluation questions with nonempty answer-session identifiers.

secondary.name: any-answer-session-hit
secondary.aggregation: Macro mean reported separately at cutoffs one, five, and ten by split and condition.
secondary.population: All development and evaluation questions with nonempty answer-session identifiers.

secondary.name: position-specificity
secondary.aggregation: Repeated adjacent-position minus recurrence-no-position and minus shuffled-position, each with mean and percentile confidence bounds.

guardrails.name: knowledge-update-top1-error
guardrails.aggregation: Macro error rate by condition and repeated-position minus content absolute difference.
guardrails.population: Held-out evaluation questions whose split metadata question_type is knowledge-update; treatment never receives the type.

guardrails.name: association-cost
guardrails.aggregation: Nearest-rank p50 and p95 for descriptive build/query milliseconds, canonical edge bytes, normalized raw session bytes, returned top-ten raw session bytes, and the per-question edge-to-raw byte ratio. Only the deterministic ratio is a decision gate.
guardrails.population: All held-out evaluation questions for each treatment condition.

guardrails.name: forbidden-field-access
guardrails.aggregation: Count treatment inputs or treatment outputs containing answer, answer-session identifiers, question type, has_answer, dates, inferred gold, or record-role labels.
guardrails.population: Every development and evaluation treatment invocation.

minimumEffect.intervalMethod: Paired unstratified percentile bootstrap over evaluation question identifiers in code-unit order with one shared 10000 by 353 index matrix from xorshift32 seed 1296387376; bounds are nearest-rank indices 249 and 9749.
minimumEffect.comparison: Repeated adjacent-position minus each of content, recurrence-no-position, and shuffled-position on identical evaluation questions.

execution.factorialDesign: Five hundred fixed LongMemEval-S questions are crossed with four retrieval conditions; development and evaluation membership is fixed before treatment projection.

casePlan.requiredWhen: Always required before an association weight can be selected or any evaluation result can be inspected.
casePlan.formula: exactly 147 development questions * 4 condition rows; those rows contain exactly 1911 weight-specific ranking vectors

casePlan.requiredWhen: Required after development selections are persisted and before a supported or rejected classification.
casePlan.formula: exactly 353 evaluation questions * 4 conditions at frozen selected weights, hence 1412 ranking vectors

execution.failurePolicy: Any dataset, protocol, preregistration, split, coverage, treatment-projection, numeric, resource, artifact-hash, independent-verification, or mutation mismatch makes the run inconclusive and prevents an efficacy classification.
execution.retryPolicy: There are no external calls and no retries; each question-condition ranking is computed and persisted exactly once.

stoppingRules.plannedCompletion: Persist the registered source hashes and split, complete every development ranking, persist all selected weights, complete every evaluation ranking without efficacy peeking, write checksums, independently verify, and reject every declared mutation.
abortConditions: Dataset length, identifiers, field shape, or SHA-256 differs from the frozen LongMemEval-S identity.
Treatment code receives or emits a forbidden gold or role field.
Any condition, split, question-condition row, selected weight, ranking cutoff, raw cost record, or required artifact is missing or duplicated.
Wall clock exceeds 1800000 milliseconds or resident memory exceeds 4294967296 bytes.
Any network request, model call, credential read, product runtime, installed Module, or paid service is attempted.
The independent analyzer imports treatment tokenization, BM25, association, shuffle, ranking, or metric code.

decisionRules.classificationOrder: Validate registered bytes, dataset identity, split, gold-blind projection, complete rankings, finite costs, checksums, independent recomputation, and mutation rejection before inspecting any useful-effect or cost threshold.
supported: Retain repeated adjacent-position retrieval for a public Agent experiment only if its evaluation NDCG@10 mean gain is at least 0.02 and paired lower 95 percent bound is above zero against content, recurrence-no-position, and shuffled-position separately.
The knowledge-update top-one error difference versus content must be at most 0.02 and the nearest-rank p95 per-question canonical-edge-byte to normalized-raw-session-byte ratio must be at most 2.
All structural, isolation, checksum, independent-verification, and mutation gates must pass.
rejected: A structurally valid miss of any useful-effect, specificity, knowledge-update, or cost threshold eliminates this repeated-position association-index design.
Prior synthetic or private-Aether results cannot reverse the rejection.
inconclusive: Any earlier structural, isolation, resource, checksum, independent-verification, or mutation failure prevents a supported or rejected classification.
A valid retrieval result cannot be promoted to an Agent, product Memory, automatic recall, task-resume, or Module-support claim.

requiredChecks: Read the registered local dataset only to verify its byte hash, shape, split metadata, and ranking relevance independently of treatment code.

Recompute the exact stratified hash split, recursive first-occurrence treatment projection, tokenizer, BM25 including empty documents, all three per-question association graphs, deterministic shuffle, development weight selection, rankings, metrics, bootstrap, canonical bytes, and decision.

Verify 500 unique questions, exact per-type split counts, 2000 condition rows, 3323 ranking vectors, the closed condition set, exact top-ten rankings, finite numbers, selected weights from the frozen grid, all required artifact hashes, and absence of configured secret values or URLs.

Prove treatment input and output artifacts contain no answer, answer-session identifiers, question type, has_answer, dates, inferred gold, or record-role fields; physical timing is audited but not expected to reproduce exactly.
mutationTests: gold-session-swap changes only split.jsonl, regenerates checksums, and must fail SPLIT_GOLD_SOURCE_MISMATCH.
projection-forbidden-field injects question_type into only the first case, regenerates checksums, and must fail PROJECTION_UNKNOWN_FIELD.
projection-message-order swaps one unequal adjacent source-message pair in cases.jsonl, regenerates checksums, and must fail PROJECTION_SOURCE_MISMATCH.
ranking-row-removed removes the first repeated-position evaluation row, regenerates checksums, and must fail EVALUATION_RANKING_COVERAGE_MISMATCH.
selected-weight-wrong-grid-member changes repeated-position to another valid grid member, regenerates checksums, and must fail SELECTED_WEIGHT_MISMATCH.
analysis-ndcg-forged changes repeated-position NDCG@10 by a frozen nonzero amount, regenerates checksums, and must fail ANALYSIS_METRIC_MISMATCH.
checksum-entry-removed removes only the analysis.json inventory line and must fail CHECKSUM_INVENTORY_SET_MISMATCH.
secret-marker-injected changes only a schema-permitted manifest string, regenerates checksums, and must fail SECRET_MARKER_LEAK without recording the marker in summaries.

domainDesign.implementationStatus: Version 3 replaces versions 1 and 2 before the first dataset run. The treatment, adapter, runner, independent analyzer, mutation harness, artifact contract, and synthetic conformance tests are frozen together by the source commit containing this preregistration. A formal run must independently prove those bytes equal its clean source commit before ranking. No formal dataset run or retrieval-outcome inspection has occurred under any version at freeze time.
domainDesign.splitProcedure: Within each question_type sort by lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of UTF-8 question_type, NUL, question_id, then code-unit question_id collision tie-break; development is first floor(0.30*n), evaluation is the remainder.
domainDesign.duplicateSessionRule: Within a question, require duplicate session IDs to have byte-identical ordered role/content arrays, retain the first occurrence, and remove later occurrences before treatment; IDs may repeat across different questions because each graph is per-question.
domainDesign.emptySessionRule: Preserve empty sessions as retrieval units with document length zero and preserve empty content strings.
domainDesign.sessionEncoding: For each supplied message in supplied order, lowercase role, colon-space, exact content, LF; apply Unicode NFKC and Unicode lowercase before tokenization.
domainDesign.associationScore: Build one complete query-independent graph per question from content token sets only. A distinct session supports an unordered pair at most once; support of at least two admits a binary-value-one edge. Candidate sessions participate in support. Candidate score is one iff an edge joins a unique query token to a candidate content token absent from the query; final score is BM25 plus selected weight times that value.
domainDesign.tieBreak: Higher final score, higher association score, higher BM25, then UTF-16 code-unit ascending session identifier.
